content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are having a great week. I have a quick note regarding the agreement: - Regarding the relevant clause, the liability cap exceeds twice the total contract value, creating excessive exposure, and we propose modifying it so that the aggregate liability of either party arising from the agreement is capped at the total fees paid under the agreement, except to the extent a different limitation is required by applicable law. Best regards.
